intuition.title: Particle packing is not atomic crystal structure
intuition.text: Figure 3 depicts layer-by-layer particle assemblies with ccp-like packing. Figure 4 depicts AB5/CaCu5-type packing formed from 4.5 and 2.6 nm CoPt3 particles. Both particle species are CoPt3; CaCu5 is a packing analogy, not another chemical phase or material made here.

intuition.title: Interparticle spacing and shell language remain qualified
intuition.text: The source first describes about 2.5 nm interparticle spacing and later uses about 2.5 nm organic-shell wording. These descriptions are retained in parallel; they are not converted into a unique radial shell thickness, molecular length or interfacial coordinate model.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
